game.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered
game.blurb: Remastered first-person shooter campaign from Raven Software, Activision and Beenox (published by Activision Blizzard), released 2016-10-05. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapter order follows the StrategyWiki walkthrough (CC BY-SA 4.0); achievements are placed by the missions their Steam text names.

chapters.title: From F.N.G. to The Bog
chapters.summary: The first six missions on the walkthrough list: F.N.G., Crew Expendable, The Coup, Blackout, Charlie Don't Surf and The Bog.

chapters.title: From Hunted to Aftermath
chapters.summary: Hunted, Death from Above, War Pig, Shock and Awe and Aftermath. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Safehouse, All Ghillied Up and One Shot, One Kill
chapters.summary: The next three missions on the list, including the long sniper stretch. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: From Heat to Game Over
chapters.summary: Heat, The Sins of the Father, Ultimatum, All In, No Fighting in the War Room and Game Over. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Mile High Club
chapters.summary: The last entry on the walkthrough list, a short mission played on Veteran for its achievement.

chapters.title: Campaign Moments
chapters.summary: Story-beat achievements whose Steam text does not name the mission, plus the one hidden achievement. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Finishing the Campaign and Veteran Runs
chapters.summary: Finishing the game on any difficulty, on Hardened or Veteran, and each group of missions on Veteran.

chapters.title: Combat Feats and Enemy Intel
chapters.summary: Headshot streaks, knife kills, explosives, helicopters, weapon variety, no-reload runs and the 30 enemy intel items.

Wiki structure from StrategyWiki under CC BY-SA 4.0 (chapter order from its walkthrough contents; titles reworded, no text copied) — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Call_of_Duty_4:_Modern_Warfare
Fandom (callofduty.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://callofduty.fandom.com/wiki/Call_of_Duty:_Modern_Warfare_Remastered
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 393080 is the standalone remaster, listed in the store as "Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® Remastered (2017)" and named "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered" in its schema; the 2007 original is a separate app (7940, "Call of Duty® 4: Modern Warfare® (2007)") and was not used. RAWG's first result is the right game (slug call-of-duty-modern-warfare-remastered); RAWG gives 2016-10-05 while the Steam store name says 2017. Route cc-by-sa: StrategyWiki redirects "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered" to "Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare", at completion stage 3; its categories include 2017, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One, so it covers the remaster too. All 21 campaign mission pages on its contents list are written (most 2,000 to 12,000 characters; The Coup is about 300 and Aftermath about 600), plus Achievements, Enemy Intelligence, Arcade Mode, weapons, perks, ranks and many multiplayer map pages. Its Gameplay, Tips, Multiplayer, Features, Glossary and Operations pages and several map pages are linked but not written. Chapters group the walkthrough missions in their contents order (grouping and titles are ours, no text copied). Only one of the 50 Steam achievements is hidden ("Time Paradox", 8.7%), and it sits in Campaign Moments. Achievements are put in a mission chapter only when their Steam text names that mission or something its title names (War Pig, the AC-130, the safehouse); seven story beats that name no mission (such as rescuing Roycewicz or carrying MacMillan) sit in Campaign Moments and could be moved to their missions by a checker. Veteran achievements that name missions sit in the Veteran chapter, except "Mile High Club". There are no multiplayer achievements. callofduty.fandom.com answers the API under this title with 500 linked articles (the query limit, so possibly more); names only were looked at, nothing copied.
